blocks.text: Setting up Google Sheets on your Mac

Google Sheets runs in your browser. It does not have a native Mac app. You can make it feel like one by turning it into a Progressive Web App. Open Chrome and go to sheets.google.com. Click the three dot menu at the top right. Select Cast, Save, and Share. Click Install page as app. This puts a dedicated icon in your dock. It keeps your sheets separate from your regular browsing tabs.
Managing customer data without the headache

Customer success work involves constant data entry. You might manage dozens of accounts at once. Use filters to keep your view clean. Click Data > Create a filter to hide rows that do not need your attention. You can also freeze rows to keep headers visible while you scroll through long lists of renewal dates.

items: ⌘ + / to open the full list of keyboard shortcuts.
⌘ + ⇧ + H to open the Find and Replace menu.
Option + / to open the tool finder search bar.

blocks.text: Handling large datasets in Google Sheets

Google Sheets now supports up to 20 million cells. Large files can still get slow. Avoid complex array formulas if you notice lag. Break your data into smaller sheets if you hit performance limits. Use the ImportRange function to pull data between different files instead of keeping everything in one massive document.

blocks.text: How Lazur helps you work faster

Lazur lives in your Mac notch. It helps you find menu items or remember shortcuts without searching. Hold ⌥ ⌘ to ask where a specific setting is. Lazur will draw a circle around the button on your screen. This is helpful when you are in a hurry during a client call.

Clean data leads to better insights. Spend time each week auditing your CRM exports. Remove duplicate rows to ensure your renewal forecasts are accurate. Use the split text to columns feature if your exported data comes in a single mess. Consistency in your naming conventions makes sorting and filtering much faster later.

faq.question: Is there an official Google Sheets app for Mac?
faq.answer: No, there is no native desktop application. You can create a shortcut in Chrome to use it as a web app.

faq.question: How do I see all keyboard shortcuts?
faq.answer: Press ⌘ + / inside any Google Sheet to open the shortcut menu.

faq.question: What is the cell limit for Google Sheets?
faq.answer: As of late 2026, the limit is 20 million cells per spreadsheet.
